common.noDriverOnDuty: No driver is on duty. Set a driver available on the drivers page.

dispatch.title: Dispatch & parcels
dispatch.description: Assign ready parcels and resolve delivery exceptions.
dispatch.tipText: Each assignment puts the parcel on the driver's run for the day, with the vehicle they have checked out. Reassignment keeps the delivery history intact.

assign.cantTitle: This parcel can't be assigned right now
assign.cantStatus: {{tracking}} is at this stage: {{status}}. Only parcels sorted in the hub or waiting for another attempt can go out with a driver.
assign.noParcel: No parcel is sorted in the hub or waiting for another attempt.
assign.newRun: Opens a new run for today
assign.title: Assign a delivery driver
assign.description: Review parcel ownership and vehicle pairing before dispatch.
assign.driverNote: Only drivers who are on duty are listed.
assign.tipTitle: A clear handoff to the field.
assign.tipText: The parcel joins the driver's run for today, with the vehicle they have checked out. Reassigning a failed attempt keeps the previous owner in the history.

details.notFound: Choose a parcel from the dispatch queue to continue.
details.failedText: Reassign the parcel for another attempt or return it to the merchant.
details.returnedText: COD was not collected. The return is recorded in the delivery history.
details.historyNote: Every scan and handoff, newest first.
details.tipText: Failed attempts and returns stay in the delivery history with their reason. Reassigning starts a new attempt; it does not erase the last one.

pickedUp.title: Mark {{tracking}} as picked up?
pickedUp.description: Records that the parcel was collected from {{merchant}}.

inHub.title: Mark {{tracking}} as in hub?
inHub.description: The parcel is sorted and becomes ready for driver assignment.

failure.title: Record a failed attempt for {{tracking}}?
failure.description: The parcel can then be reassigned for another attempt or returned to the merchant.

return.title: Return {{tracking}} to sender?
return.description: The parcel goes back to {{merchant}}. COD is not collected and the return is recorded in the delivery history.
return.recorded: Recorded on the parcel with your account.

create.title: New parcel
create.description: Create a waybill and schedule its pickup from the merchant.
create.noMerchants: This company has no active merchants yet. Add a client first.
create.tipText: The tracking number is generated when you save. It goes on the barcode and is what the recipient uses to track the parcel.

deliver.cantText: Only a parcel that is out for delivery can have its delivery recorded.
deliver.locationUnavailable: Not available. You can still record the delivery.
deliver.title: Record delivery of {{tracking}}
deliver.tipText: The signature, photo and location are attached to the parcel and shown in its details.

track.title: Track a parcel
track.intro: Enter the tracking number from your waybill to see where your parcel is.
track.privacy: Tracking shows the parcel's status and times only — never the recipient, the address or the payment.
track.noMatch: No parcel matches {{tracking}}. Check the number on your waybill and try again.
